### Function
「... ~ ...」*conjunction of alternatives:* or
### Semanticization
*Appending a [[Sen'fi/Glossary/Grammar/(tse)\|tse]] glyph yields **[[]]***
### Etymology
#### Glyph
- an ideograph of a fork in the path, both ways leading to their own "thing".
- Influenced by the logical disjunction symbol ∨ & by the sitelen pona for "anu".
- Coincidentally 丫 is a Chinese character depicting something forked.
#### Sound
- *a priori:* e=neutral/flexible
